svg.title: ThingsBoard release-3.6 - failure recovery and observability

g.text: Transport sessions, service restart, and subscription repair
remove subscription ownership for stopped Core
The shared cache contains metadata, nodeId, activity, and subscription flags.
It does not contain a live socket or SessionMsgListener.
SYNC sessions are excluded from the snapshot.
OtherServiceShutdownEvent is not sent directly to DeviceActor.
Subscription ownership cleanup and Actor partition adjustment are distinct flows.
ASYNC metadata snapshot or decode failure
push UPDATED subscriptions to new Core partitions
CoreStartupMsg repairs telemetry/WebSocket subscription ownership only.
It is not a barrier for all service state and does not restore transport connections.
